Pokémon Go!, also known as Go Pokémon Go, is an English song used in the Pokémon animated series. It was first used as the opening and ending theme for the special The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon, and was later used as the ending theme of the English dub of Pokémon: Battle Frontier, which encompasses the episodes from Fear Factor Phony to Home is Where the Start Is!.

The original airing of the English dub and the Japanese version of The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon use the rap portion of the song as both the opening and ending, while the English redub changes the opening to use a different part of the song. A shortened version of the rap portion was used as the ending for Battle Frontier, making it the only original ending theme to be used in the English dub of , as otherwise ending themes for the English dub have been shortened or instrumental versions of the opening themes.

The full version is available on the CD, and was also featured in the music video in the 10th Anniversary Perdue Farms promotion.

Pokémon Go!, also known as Go Pokémon Go, is an English song used in the Pokémon animated series. It was first used as the opening and ending theme for the special The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon, and was later used as the ending theme of the English dub of Pokémon: Battle Frontier, which encompasses the episodes from Fear Factor Phony to Home is Where the Start Is!.

The original airing of the English dub and the Japanese version of The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon use the rap portion of the song as both the opening and ending, while the English redub changes the opening to use a different part of the song. A shortened version of the rap portion was used as the ending for Battle Frontier, making it the only original ending theme to be used in the English dub of , as otherwise ending themes for the English dub have been shortened or instrumental versions of the opening themes.

The full version is available on the CD, and was also featured in the music video in the 10th Anniversary Perdue Farms promotion.

These lists only cover the two openings of The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon. All other occurrences of this song in the animated series have no background animation and thus have no characters in them.

==Trivia==
This is the only English dub theme to be used in the original Japanese version.
The and the dubs used an instrumental version of the track as the ending for Battle Frontier, rather than a dubbed version or the English version.

===Errors===
